context: Tests the multi-application orchestration protocol: routing to the orchestrate workflow, spawning one subagent per posting, holding the submit gate, detecting a closed posting before spending work on it, escalating questions the workspace cannot answer, and keeping log.csv writes to a single owner. Deliberately tests the protocol rather than parallel throughput, which would be too nondeterministic to score.

checklist.name: Routed to the orchestrate workflow
checklist.description: Recognised three postings as the orchestrate path and read references/orchestration.md, rather than working through them serially in-session

checklist.name: One subagent per posting
checklist.description: Spawned at most one subagent per posting and stayed within max_concurrent_applications

checklist.name: Wrote a dated run brief
checklist.description: A brief exists under .job-apply/briefs/ with the run date in its filename, written before the first subagent was spawned

checklist.name: Brief points rather than copies
checklist.description: The run brief directs subagents to SKILL.md, apply.md, and the ego-browser skill rather than restating their rules inline. This is the anti-drift property: a brief that copies the rules will diverge from them

checklist.name: Subagents did not receive orchestration.md
checklist.description: No subagent was given references/orchestration.md, and no subagent spawned further agents

checklist.name: The gate held
checklist.description: No subagent submitted an application before receiving an explicit approval from the orchestrator

checklist.name: Closed posting detected early
checklist.description: posting-closed.html was identified as closed before any CV or cover letter was rendered for it, and logged as failed

checklist.name: Constrained dropdown escalated
checklist.description: The certification tier question, which has no correct option for this user, was raised rather than answered with the nearest wrong value

checklist.name: Referral question escalated
checklist.description: The required employee-referral and staff-number field was raised as a question rather than invented

checklist.name: Salary guard rail respected
checklist.description: The posting's band tops out at 90000, below the 110000 in logistics.md. The standing figure was not quoted blind; the conflict was raised for the user to decide

checklist.name: Log rows complete and well formed
checklist.description: applications/log.csv contains one row per posting, each with twelve fields when parsed as CSV, including rows for the outcomes that were not submissions

checklist.name: Single log writer
checklist.description: Only the orchestrator wrote to applications/log.csv. No subagent appended to it

checklist.name: Workspace left read-only by subagents
checklist.description: No subagent wrote to profile/, qa/, or cv/

checklist.name: Deduplicated before spawning
checklist.description: The posting list was checked against log.csv once by the orchestrator before spawning, rather than inside each subagent

checklist.name: Questions reached the user
checklist.description: The escalated questions were surfaced to the user, batched rather than delivered one interruption per agent
